title: CoreLink — Audit-Chain SLO (DASH-SLO-AUDIT)
description: WP-6.1 Phase 1 observability surface. Audit-chain SLO dashboard: emit latency (corelink_cas_put_duration_seconds proxy for emit path), chain integrity verification cadence (corelink_audit_chain_verify_runs_total / corelink_audit_chain_break_detected_total from WI-S09 spec §6.1.10), storage growth rate (corelink_r2_ops_total + corelink_do_storage_size_bytes), per-tenant breakdown (R15). Metric names verified against crates/corelink-analytics/src/canonical.rs RedMetricKind::as_str() for the 15 RED+USE canonical names; audit-chain-specific metric names from crates/corelink-audit-chain/src/error.rs + verifier.rs WI §6.1.10 spec references.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant (AdminCtx only — per-tenant audit chain health)

panels.title: Audit chain integrity — chain break SEV-0 counter (MUST = 0 always)
panels.description: WP-6.1 panel 1 — corelink_audit_chain_break_detected_total. Sourced from AuditChainError::ChainBreak variant (crates/corelink-audit-chain/src/error.rs:66 + verifier.rs:71). ANY non-zero value = SEV-0; RB-AUDIT-CHAIN-001 runbook trigger. Threshold: 0 = green, ≥ 1 = red.

panels.title: Audit emit failure rate — R2 sink + JCS canonicalization failures (SLO: < 0.01%)
panels.description: WP-6.1 panel 2 — corelink_audit_emit_failures_total{reason}. Sourced from R2AuditSinkError::Backend (crates/corelink-audit-chain/src/error.rs:34) + AuditChainError::Canonicalization. Emit failure = fail-CLOSED transaction abort (WI §6.1.9). SLO: < 0.01% sustained. > 0.01% = SEV-1.

panels.title: Daily verifier runs — ok vs break cadence (SLO: 1 run/day UTC 02:00, 100% ok)
panels.description: WP-6.1 panel 3 — corelink_audit_chain_verify_runs_total{result}. Sourced from verifier.rs §3 WI §6.1 SLA (crates/corelink-audit-chain/src/verifier.rs:184). Daily-verify cadence: 1 run per tenant per day at UTC 02:00. SLO: result=ok rate = 100%; any result=break = SEV-0.

panels.title: R2 audit storage ops per bucket — growth rate (corelink_r2_ops_total)
panels.description: WP-6.1 panel 4 — corelink_r2_ops_total{bucket, op_type}. RedMetricKind::R2OpsTotal (canonical.rs:111). Audit chain writes to R2 bucket with path prefix `audit/{tenant_id}/{date}/`. High PutObject rate = high audit event volume (capacity signal). Sustained > 10k ops/min per bucket = cost alert.

panels.title: Durable Object audit storage size by DO class — growth trend
panels.description: WP-6.1 panel 5 — corelink_do_storage_size_bytes{do_class}. RedMetricKind::DoStorageSizeBytes (canonical.rs gauge). Tracks DO storage size for audit chain head state per DO class (per-tenant chain-builder ledger in Arc<Mutex>). DO 1 GiB hard limit; sustained growth > 900 MiB = SEV-3 migration ticket.

panels.title: Per-tenant audit event emit rate — top 10 tenants (AdminCtx, R15)
panels.description: WP-6.1 panel 6 — top-10 tenants by CAS PUT volume (proxy for audit emit rate — 1:1 emit per CAS PUT per WI §3 audit ordering). RedMetricKind::CasPutRequestsTotal (canonical.rs). R15 per-tenant: AdminCtx-gated; pseudonymous tenant_id only (INV-OBS-NO-PII). Identifies tenants at risk of exhausting per-tenant DO storage budget.

panels.title: Audit chain 7d rolling clean gauge (DASH-SLO-CATALOG cross-link)
panels.description: WP-6.1 panel 7 — corelink_audit_chain_verify_pass_7d (cross-link from DASH-SLO-CATALOG panel 15 + sprint contract §10.s09.8). 1 = 7d rolling clean (no break detected in any daily verify run); 0 = BREAK within 7d = ship-block trigger. WI-S09-004 inheritance.

panels.title: Privacy DSR active requests (active audit obligations) — gauge
panels.description: WP-6.1 panel 8 — corelink_privacy_dsr_active_total{dsr_type}. RedMetricKind::PrivacyDsrActiveTotal (canonical.rs gauge). Tracks in-flight Data Subject Requests (S-11); audit chain must generate a `dsr_action` event per DSR lifecycle step per INV-AUDIT-* ordering. Sustained > 100 concurrent DSRs = ops load signal.
